name: SegFormer
plain: NVIDIA's SegFormer: a transformer for ADE20K scene segmentation (sizes B0 and B5), plus two community fine-tunes: clothes parsing (B2, 18 classes) and face parsing (B5, 19 classes). Non-commercial weights.
summary: SegFormer (Xie et al. 2021): hierarchical Mix Transformer encoder (overlapping patch embeddings, reduced-key attention, Mix-FFN) and an all-MLP decoder.

papers.title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers

official.reason: The authors' code needs mmsegmentation; the transformers port is self-contained.

task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: per-pixel class labels (logits with `logits=True`).

quality.protocol: Scores use one pixel confusion matrix across the split. Left and right eyes share one class, and left and right brows share one class. Labels outside the eight shared foreground classes count as background.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.1 (absolute error of the output `logits`).
